# Papers on LLM Jailbreak Techniques

Here are some notable research papers on LLM jailbreaking:

## Early/Foundational Work

1. **"Jailbroken: How Does LLM Safety Training Fail?"** (2023)
   - Examines competing objectives and mismatched generalization in safety training

2. **"Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Language Models"** (Zou et al., 2023)
   - Introduces adversarial suffix attacks (GCG - Greedy Coordinate Gradient)
   - Shows automated methods to generate jailbreak prompts

3. **"Ignore Previous Prompt: Attack Techniques For Language Models"** (Perez & Ribeiro, 2022)
   - Early work on prompt injection attacks

## Specific Techniques

4. **"Tree of Attacks: Jailbreaking Black-Box LLMs Automatically"** (2024)
   - Automated red-teaming using tree-of-thought methods

5. **"Low-Resource Languages Jailbreak GPT-4"** (2024)
   - Exploits multilingual capabilities for bypassing safeguards

6. **"Do Anything Now: Characterizing and Evaluating In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts"** (2023)
   - Analyzes real-world jailbreak attempts (DAN prompts)

## Survey Papers

7. **"Jailbreak and Guard Aligned Language Models"** (2024)
   - Comprehensive survey of attack and defense methods
